scope: Ten completed Qwen3.5 2B Q4_K_M GCP scalar judge-prompt requests. This fixed-budget local rubric is not official judging, ARC-Easy accuracy or the composite ADTC score.
policy: All ten exact prompts, full answer fields and full reasoning_content fields were read. Only substantive delivered final text earns points; separate reasoning is excluded.
Every original criterion label and weight is retained. Manual semantic judgments, not keyword matching, decide the awarded points.
An empty final receives zero on every criterion, even if correct work is present in reasoning or an error-avoidance criterion would otherwise pass.
A substantive partial final could receive completed-criterion credit, but no partial finals occur in this set.
The fixed 1,024-token output budget includes reasoning. These scores measure delivered answers under that cap, not unconstrained reasoning capability.
The concise-response criterion retains the existing 500-character threshold. Both completed short answers also satisfy the requested calculation or explanatory-sentence format.
The proportional-model prompt appears at two retained positions; the set contains nine unique prompt wordings.
GCP scalar results remain separate from the completed Mac Metal assessment.
The 1,024-token cap is the campaign's local generation setting; it is not represented as an official competition judge limit.

source_snapshot.scope: Exact captured prefix of a growing append-only JSONL file; individual record hashes exclude newline.

independent_review.scope: Independent judgment before consulting the primary decisions: read all ten exact prompts and final fields, plus complete reasoning corresponding to the two delivered finals; checked all completion states.
findings: The chalk and photosynthesis final responses each satisfy all four rubric criteria, earning 10 points each.
Eight other requests have empty final fields, nonempty separate reasoning and length termination at 1,024 tokens; no partial final occurs.
No borderline deduction or disagreement remains.

models.source_sha256_scope: First 467988 bytes / 100 records captured for this review; source may grow.
observations: Both short multiple-choice final answers are correct and satisfy the requested calculation or explanatory sentence.
All eight other requests stop at the local output cap before final text, including every human-judge prompt.
This review concerns the Q4_K_M artifact, not the separately tested Q4_0 model; no Mac grades are substituted.

prompts.title: Two Sigma proportional model

as personalization tends to zero the rate tends to zero
as personalization tends to infinity the linear rate is unbounded
defines the variables and positive proportionality constant
does not invent a square-root-of-two constant or Kahneman attribution

prompts.reason: The answer field is empty. Repeated Two Sigma interpretation and proposed proportionality remain separate reasoning only, so no model or limits are delivered.

prompts.reason: The answer field is empty. A correct ODE derivation and initial-condition calculation occur only in reasoning and receive no delivered-final credit.
